oc_status.note: Project is being implemented, apartments that are already booked with other allottees should not be attached so that the project can be completed.

deadline.event: full refund of the amount to the complainant

reliefs.reasoning: The respondent was directed to refund the principal amount along with interest at 10.25% p.a. from the date of receipt till full refund.
Respondent was directed to pay a cost of Rs. 10,000/- to the complainant.

supplementary_proceedings.reasoning: Complainants filed 16 applications for non-compliance as respondent failed to refund amounts with interest. Respondent did not appear despite notice. MahaRERA directed to issue individual recovery warrants under section 40(1) of RERA. The 16 applications stand disposed of.

extraction_notes: The `from_date` for interest accrual is described as 'from the dates of their payment' in the Final Order, which cannot be represented as a single fixed date in the `from_date` field. It is therefore set to null. The `complainant_count` is set to 1 because the overarching warrant document specifically targets one complaint number, even though the underlying non-compliance application addressed 16 clubbed complaints. The top-level 'coram' is set to the signatory of the most recent warrant document.
